subject: english
meaning_en: A departure from what is normal, usual, or expected.
meaning_hi: सामान्य या अपेक्षित स्थिति से भटकाव; असामान्यता।
mnemonic: AB (Away) + ERR (Error/भटकना) → Jo apne normal track se bhatak gaya = Anomaly.
example: The sudden spike in inflation was an aberration due to monsoon delays.

subject: english
meaning_en: A harsh, discordant mixture of sounds.
meaning_hi: कर्कश, अप्रिय और अशांत ध्वनियों का मिश्रण।
mnemonic: CACO (Bad/खराब) + PHON (Sound/आवाज) → Kaan ko chubhney wali awaz = Harsh noise.
example: The cacophony of street horns made focus impossible during the mock test.

subject: english
meaning_en: Lasting for a very short time; transitory.
mnemonic: E-PHEMERAL sounds like 'FEEM' (Foam) → Foam lasts only seconds = Short-lived.
example: Social media outrage is usually ephemeral, fading within forty-eight hours.

subject: banking-awareness
meaning_en: The percentage of a bank's Net Demand and Time Liabilities (NDTL) that it must keep in cash with the RBI.
meaning_hi: बैंक की कुल जमा पूंजी (NDTL) का वह प्रतिशत जिसे नकद रूप में RBI के पास रखना अनिवार्य होता है।
mnemonic: CASH + RESERVE with RBI → Banks earn ZERO interest on this amount. Direct liquidity tool.
antonyms: Statutory Liquidity Ratio (kept with self in gold/gov bonds)
example: When RBI increases CRR, available lending capital shrinks, controlling inflation.

subject: quant
example: Calculating 14.28% of 350? Simply divide 350 by 7 = 50 immediately.
